question: Show Gastric/GEJ trials using PD1 where PD‑L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.

llm.answer: Trials for Gastric/GEJ using PD1 where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.
llm.assumptions: Assuming PD-L1 positivity inclusion criteria is binary (Yes/No) and PD1 is the exact match for the ICI class.
